name: workflow
description: A small engineering workflow for planning, implementation, review, technical writing, and guided walkthroughs.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, verify, explain, and review engineering work.
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills cover planning artifacts, authorized engineering changes, concise technical writing, adversarial design interviews, and evidence-backed walkthroughs. Guidance is loaded progressively and keeps changes bounded, simple, reusable, and independently verifiable.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow:engineering for authorized code changes, debugging, refactoring, review corrections, and final verification.
Use $workflow:planning for specs, plans, tasks, tickets, and design exploration; use $workflow:technical-writing for prose.
Invoke $workflow:grill-me or $workflow:walkthrough explicitly when you want those interactive review modes.
